verdict.rationale: A commerce platform could plausibly offer user-configurable background automations, so this axis applies. The evidence pack documents no such feature. Square AI (Beta) is described as an on-demand assistant that answers questions about seller data; it does not run scheduled or autonomous jobs. Webhooks, the MCP server, and the SDKs are developer building blocks that someone could use to construct automations, not an automation feature themselves. Fraud rules and alerts and recurring subscriptions are adjacent features, not general background automations the user sets up.
